hook: I checked every submission by hand for 12 years. Now an agent does it in 2 minutes
caption:
I checked every submission by hand for 12 years. Now an agent does it in 2 minutes.

Before: a checklist and a tired evening. Reviewing every submission by memory, one mistake away from missing a deadline.

Now: upload, review, two minutes. The agent flags what's missing or off — I still make the call, just faster.

Not "AI does everything." One narrow task I used to do by hand the same way for over a decade — just faster now, and without the evening fatigue.

Still checking submissions by hand? DM me AGENT — I'll show you how it works.
